checks.name: App Store benchmark metadata and ten-level route are explicit
203 unique authored assets cover every item/producer grade and exact file hashes
Fresh 7×9 board has three reachable orders, one producer and no clothing-name/icon alias
Nearest output costs exactly one energy; full board and zero energy are atomic
Merge conserves canonical units; different/max tier swaps and cancelled moves cannot lose items
Delivery validates every requirement first, consumes production stock once, and cannot pay twice
UI delivery adapter preserves imported high-balance saves and uses the existing currency cap
Storage recall, 10-second recycle undo and split card preserve inventory
Production charge fractional recovery survives save/reload; idle time cannot reset it for free
V51 save migrates once without changing old materials, active orders, closet or mall
All 7 families, 14 chains and 9 producer grades obey source/capacity/boost/tier constraints
First 10 tutorial orders are playable by actual producer output, merge, grant and upgrade actions
Publishing and drama choices award once, increase mall income, open tiles and survive reload
Recurring order supply unlocks every secondary chain through real part merges without repeat grants
New workshop progress opens mall expansion, second shop and outfit journal without faking legacy clothing
A delayed unload save cannot disable refreshed progress, but a newer or removed save remains protected
Invalid order references/duplicate item ids fail loudly without resetting progress
